text:
Amélie Duarte: Hi everyone 44b I'm Ame9lie, starting today on Eng Runtime (remote, LIS). Quick questions: who do I ping for SSH/VPN and MDM enrollment? I usually run Linux (Pop!_OS) 10 and prefer to use my own laptop — is that OK? Also curious whether we have a recommended devcontainer / reproducible dev env or should I build locally. Oh and fun fact: I play clarinet in a community band :)

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ame9lie!! :tada: Buddy assigned: Noel C. We'll ship a welcome box to EU addresses  just fill the swag form: https://redwood.company/swag-form. Any dietary restrictions?

Noel Chen: hey Ame9lie 44b i'll DM you and set a 30-min onboarding sync. For SSH/VPN open IT portal (https://it.redwood/portal) and paste your public key. We support BYOD but require MDM enrollment + full-disk encryption and company profile. If you prefer we can ship a company laptop instead.

IT-Bot: IT ticket created: #IT-9122 "Onboard Ame9lie Duarte - VPN/SSH/MDM/BYOD"  assigned to eng-ops. ETA 1 business day.

Asha (DevEx): For dev envs we have a maintained devcontainer: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/dev-environments.git && cd runtime-dev && code --folder-uri .`  it has a devcontainer.json and a make target `make dev` to bootstrap. If you prefer local Linux workflows we support that too; ping me and I can share our minimal dotfiles and karabiner-like key remapping for Linux.

Luca (Eng): If you're using Pop!_OS, you should be fine. Note: if you want GPU inference testing locally ask me about the remote notebook images; we have a CPU-only local profile in the repo so you don't need CUDA straight away. I'll add you to the repo ACLs once IT clears the ticket.

FedEx-Bot: Shipping request submitted for welcome box to: Ame9lie Duarte, Lisbon. Tracking ETA 3-5 business days.

Ame9lie Duarte: Thanks all 60a I'll submit the portal ticket and DM Noel my public key. No dietary restrictions. Clarinet waves hi :musical_score: Looking forward to the sync and trying the devcontainer. Also keen to meet folks in SF when I visit 30f

Maya (People Ops): Noted, welcome again! We'll book a desk for you when you're in SF  ping @noel to coordinate travel/desk.

Noel Chen: Added you to #eng-runtime and calendar invites. See you on the sync in 30. If anything blocks with Linux provisioning, @asha and I will do a quick pairing session.
